title: Road to the platinum
intro: Seven stages drawn from the official descriptions. The order protects every story-bound trophy first, then sweeps the map in one pass, and leaves the 100% audit for last so it can only confirm what is already done.

pointOfNoReturn.title: Point of no return
pointOfNoReturn.body: Save in a new slot before you launch the final mission. Every stranger strand, partner run and choice beat in stages 2 and 3 has to be finished by then; once the credits roll those offers stop appearing, and no amount of cleanup brings them back.

stages.title: Story run — Chapters 1 to 4
stages.note: Play the campaign first: it unlocks the map, the partner, the businesses and most of the activity markers. Each chapter trophy and each named mission trophy is a completion flag, so nothing here can be lost once the mission is finished. Tick them as they land and use the chapter breaks as cleanup gates rather than racing ahead.

stages.title: Stranger strands
stages.note: Six named strands plus the silver for eight completed lines. Run each strand as its markers appear and finish it before Chapter 4 closes. This is the stage players most often lose to the endgame, because an open strand leaves no warning on the map once the final mission is live.

stages.title: Partner, choices and one-off moments
stages.note: The partner wanted-level runs, the story-choice bronzes and the flavour beats. Do them while the story is live, keep a save before each one-time scene, and take the retry prompt rather than reloading when a mission offers it. None of these survive the point of no return.

stages.title: Collectibles sweep
stages.note: 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK check-ins, 100 vehicles, 52 areas, 8 garages and 10 app registrations. Route by district and let one drive feed several counters: a meditation stop is also a check-in, and a new district usually has a vehicle worth registering on the way through.

stages.title: Activities
stages.note: One round of each of the nine activity types first, then the long ones: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins, plus fishing, arcade and bowling. The skill checks reward a slow learning pass followed by a fast clean one; the grinds reward short sessions.

stages.title: Crime and challenges
stages.note: Five bank vaults, an armored truck, a silent jewelry job, nine gang operations, 50 challenges, the two money counters and the VCIA escape. Heist income funds the shopping trophies, so launder and spend as you go rather than saving both counters for the end.

stages.title: 100% and the platinum
stages.note: The pause-menu completion audit is the final word. It names the category that is short, so work from its list instead of a fan-made checklist, clear whatever it still shows, and the platinum arrives on its own with nothing left to trigger.
stages.why: 2 trophies: the 100% gold and the platinum.
